# VigioDesk

> VigioDesk (vigodesk.com) — convert, merge, split, and protect PDFs online; eSign with audit trails; employee Letter Studio; Diagram Studio; and AI website audits. Fast, privacy-first document tools for modern teams.

## Services
- Online PDF tools (merge, split, compress, convert, protect, OCR)
- Electronic signatures with cryptographic audit trails
- Bulk employee letters from Excel
- Browser diagram / flowchart editor
- Website SEO + Core Web Vitals + AI-search audits
